static_traits.name: Lin Danni
static_traits.occupation: recent High school graduate (about to enter university)
static_traits.educational_background: High school graduate; about to attend the University of Kentucky
static_traits.family_status: Has two brothers, family supportiveness Good
static_traits.social_status: Interpersonal relationshipsGood, good relationships with brothers and friends, but they do not know about her intense Fear of failing courses
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; no history of similar psychological problems; has not received psychotherapy or counseling yet
static_traits.language_features: Neutral tone, slightly tense; clear expression, logical; able to Reflect on own cognitions and evidence, fairly cooperative

basic_info.main_problem: I have a persistent thought that I might fail the first semester of university, this makes me very Anxious and stressed.
basic_info.core_demands: The Fear of failure constantly occupies my thoughts and affects physical and mental health, therefore hoping to relieve Anxiety through counseling before enrollment.
growth_experiences: Academic performance Good in the High school stage, overall functioning stable; in the transition period before entering university, high self-Demands, adaptation to the new environment full of uncertainty, gradually affecting self-confidence.

Starting from late High school, initially excited about university; as the university start date approaches, due to worrying about being unable to cope with new academic Demands and environment, developing an intense Fear of 'failing the first semester'; this Fear repeatedly appearing daily, especially obvious when Being alone, falling asleep or eating; although having supportive family and friends, has not yet revealed this intense Fear of failure to them, Anxiety gradually affecting sleep and diet.

core_beliefs: I am not capable enough, finding it hard to cope with university academic Demands
If I fail, I will disappoint my family

special_situations.event: As the start of university approaches, when Being alone, repeatedly thinking about future university Learning and environment
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot adapt to the new environment and academic Demands, I will fail courses and disappoint my family
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries self-soothing and attending to positive outcomes; looks up university resources in advance and formulates study plans
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will probably fail the first semester

special_situations.event: Comparing High school and university difficulty, believing university is harder and different from past experience
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: University is harder than High school, my past grades cannot show future success; if unable to fully control, may fail
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Ignoring positive evidence (High school grades Good), only focusing on potential difficulties and threats
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I may not be able to handle university courses

special_situations.event: When trying to sleep or eat, worries about failing courses repeatedly appear and intensify
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot relieve Anxiety in daily life, it means I cannot cope with university pressure, will ultimately fail
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids sharing specific fears with others, worrying alone repeatedly to try to maintain a sense of control
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I may break down; I will very likely fail courses in the first semester

special_situations.event: When thinking about family's expectations and support
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I fail the first semester, will disappoint my family, proving I am not good enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Keeping Fear in the heart, not revealing deeply to family or friends to avoid being evaluated

core_conflict.wish: Longs to maintain academic success in the new environment and continue gaining family's recognition and support
core_conflict.fear: Fearing failure being seen as lack of ability, thus disappointing family, losing the feeling of being recognized
defense_goal: Protecting self-esteem through control and self-restraint, avoiding exposing vulnerability; not revealing specific Fear to family and friends to reduce the risk of being judged

object_relations.self_representation: a hardworking Student prone to Self-doubt
object_relations.object_representation: Family / others who are supportive but may be disappointed by failure

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When talking about 'possibly failing a course' or being asked whether she shares such worries with family
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: The client tends to think expressing Fear will disappoint others, making oneself appear incapable (transference: Projecting family's expectations into the counseling relationship)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Tone gentle, supportive; first normalizing her worries, then gently exploring her not-yet-expressed emotions and needs with open-ended questions; avoiding evaluation, allowing pauses, inviting her to concretize feelings and imagined consequences.

manifestations: When Being alone, thinking about the future, Increasing worry
Not yet revealing Intense fear of failure to family and friends, choosing to bear it alone
Worrying about being unable to integrate into the university environment and academic Demands

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Expressing at the start of the session 'a bit nervous, not sure what will happen'
Repeatedly doubts and negatively evaluates one's abilities
Not yet sharing specific Fear with the support system, expressing cautiously for fear of disappointing family

positive_force: Having supportive family and friend relationships
Academic performance Good in the High school stage, having diligence and Learning ability
Willing to proactively seek counseling and plan learning resources before enrollment (such as tutoring centers, study groups, making study plans)
negative_force: Catastrophizing and future-predicting cognitive patterns Reinforcing failure Anxiety
Persistent doubts about own abilities leading to Decreased confidence
Suppressing Fear in important relationships, not yet receiving outside support in time, Loneliness burden increasing

target_behavior.behavior: Excessive worry and Fear of failure about the upcoming university Learning (Anxiety)
antecedent: As the start of university approaches
Being alone and thinking about the future
Thinking university is harder than High school
When trying to sleep or eat
target_behavior.core_reason: High uncertainty about the new environment and academic Demands and worry about disappointing family, forming catastrophic Anticipation of failure
target_behavior.function: Through continuous worrying and rehearsing worst outcomes to seek a sense of control and prepare in advance, while avoiding discussing with others to avoid being evaluated
target_behavior.consequence: Anxiety intensified, Sleep and diet affected, Decreased self-confidence, not yet fully utilizing Social support
